settings.minimal_pve_role: VM.Config.Network + VM.Audit; add VM.Snapshot for snapshot
settings.scope: Grant the role on the permitted pool or VM path.
settings.token: Use a privilege-separated API token; both the user and token need the scoped permissions.
settings.identity: source must match the Proxmox source name in netnoodle; replace cluster-name in allow targets with the API cluster name, or standalone for a single node.
settings.protection: never_isolate must include all management, router and VPN guests. Empty lists require allow_empty_never_isolate: true. max_snapshots caps snapshots named nn-* per guest (default 3).
settings.secret: Store the token secret in the file below (mode 0600 recommended). Set exactly one of token_secret and token_secret_file.
